# Repository Instructions

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), the canonical AI engineering agreement, before making changes. It defines required reading, sprint execution, coding standards, verification, privacy, and handoff rules.

Start each session with [the sprint board](../docs/SPRINTS.md) and [the handoff](../docs/HANDOFF.md). Keep all repository content and public GitHub communication in English. Use the canonical documents instead of maintaining separate rules here.
